scope.corpus: Evolution House archetypes SEO production drafts
scope.purpose: Trace every published-attribution scene or method claim from route_id and draft locator to its source, permission boundary, allowed claim, and forbidden extension.
scope.primary_source_rule: Full VTT files are primary for training content. Clean Markdown files are navigation aids only. A brief or critic audit is used as the source_path only when the primary source lacks an exact locator in the production record.
scope.publication_rule: status=needs_locator is a publication evidence gap for the attributed item; it must not be presented as primary-source-verified until an exact locator is added.

status_values.verified: The cited source and locator are specific enough to retrieve the supporting passage.
status_values.needs_locator: The production brief or audit confirms the source relationship, but no exact primary-source locator is recorded.

consent_states.author_first_person: Author-owned first-person material; publish only the facts supported by the cited passage.
consent_states.user_confirmed_except_margarita: The user confirmed permission to use training cases, except Margarita and any recognisable anonymisation of her story.
consent_states.editorial_illustration: A constructed ordinary-life illustration, not a participant or client history.
consent_states.method_or_public_source: No participant consent is implicated; normal attribution and claim-boundary rules still apply.

global_deny_rules.note: The prohibition remains in force even when general permission exists for other training cases.

evidence_items.draft_locator: source-refresh case about macrame and turning pleasure into a large business
evidence_items.scene_summary: A participant postponed macrame for almost half a year; it had been pleasurable until she immediately framed it as a large business.
evidence_items.speaker: anonymous training participant; Svetlana Strauss
evidence_items.allowed_claim: Pleasure can be displaced when a desired activity is immediately converted into a large obligation; Svetlana suggested first restoring its right to remain pleasurable.
evidence_items.forbidden_extension: Do not claim that the participant returned to macrame, built a business, or achieved a later result; the source does not report the continuation.

evidence_items.scene_summary: A participant had not made macrame for nearly half a year and realised that the pleasure disappeared when she decided it had to become a large business.
evidence_items.speaker: anonymous training participant; Svetlana Strauss
evidence_items.allowed_claim: Pleasure disappeared when the participant immediately converted macrame into a large business obligation; Svetlana answered: «Отстань от меня, дай мне сначала получить удовольствие».
evidence_items.forbidden_extension: Do not identify the participant or claim that she returned to macrame, built a business, earned money, or achieved a later result.

evidence_items.scene_summary: Svetlana began singing at about forty-nine, created the programme Five Seasons of a Woman, and performed it in different hotels.
evidence_items.speaker: Svetlana Strauss
evidence_items.allowed_claim: The singing history may illustrate desire followed by real participation and action.
evidence_items.forbidden_extension: Do not invent preparation details, clients, audience reaction, commercial outcomes, or causal effects of an archetype.

evidence_items.scene_summary: Svetlana's first concert before an unfamiliar foreign audience was in India on her birthday; she was frightened, forgot many words, made mistakes, and still treated it as an important passage.
evidence_items.speaker: Svetlana Strauss
evidence_items.allowed_claim: The imperfect first concert may illustrate a desired life beginning through participation rather than instant mastery.
evidence_items.forbidden_extension: Do not invent the venue, programme reception, audience size, income, later success, or a guaranteed archetypal cause.
